sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vibhu Rai,Jitendra Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.
Heard counsel for the applicant and Sri Neeraj Kumar Sharma, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 0483 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 & 471 I.P.C.,
Police Station- Kotwali, District- Ballia during pendency of the trial.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The applicant had appeared in the concerned examination.
No one appeared on behalf of the applicant.
At the time of examination, the credentials of the applicant were duly verified.
Without conducting any verification of the documents/material, the instant prosecution has been instituted against the applicant.

The applicant is in jail since 06.09.2023, having no criminal history, and in Dharmendra Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14874660/

sentences.text: is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid facts from the record.
5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record this Court prima facie finds that at present, there is no substantive evidence against the applicant.

The applicant has no criminal antecedents and has remained confined for more than two months and after submission of the charge-sheet there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case
, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. Let the applicant, Dharmendra Yadav involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned on the following conditions that:
i. the applicant shall not temper with the prosecution evidence; ii. the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witness; and, iii. the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
Order Date :- 17.11.2023 Sachin Mishra  Dharmendra Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14874660/
